bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 回调靠近 30 日均线

read.en: AMD fell 2.3% on Oct 12 to $594.24, 10% below its Oct 6 record of $658.52. It has dropped under its 5 and 10-day averages ($622–624) but stays well above the 30-day ($564), 100-day ($522) and 200-day ($387), all rising. MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 9 (still above zero), Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Oct 8, and RSI is 53.
read.zh: AMD 10月12日下跌 2.3%，收于 $594.24，较 10月6日纪录高点 $658.52 回落 10%。股价已跌破 5 日和 10 日均线（$622–624），但仍远高于 30 日（$564）、100 日（$522）和 200 日（$387）均线，且均线均在上行。MACD 于 10月9日下穿信号线（仍在零轴上方），抛物线 SAR 于 10月8日转空，RSI 为 53。

read.en: The late-September pivot at $586–590 held on Oct 12 (low $586.54). A close below it opens the 30-day average at $564, then $525 near the 100-day. Resistance is the 5 and 10-day averages at $622–624, then the Oct 6–7 closes at $646–649 and the $658.5 record.
read.zh: 9月下旬转折点 $586–590 在 10月12日守住（低点 $586.54）。若收盘跌破，下看 $564 的 30 日均线，再看 100 日均线附近的 $525。阻力为 $622–624 的 5 日和 10 日均线，其次 10月6–7日收盘价 $646–649 及 $658.5 纪录高点。
